guia.what: Three animated dots that signal activity subtly, designed to sit inline next to text or inside a button. They inherit `currentColor`.
whenUse: The loading signal sits inline and shouldn’t grab attention.
You’re replacing a button’s text while a form submits.
The wait is brief, and a spinner looks heavy next to the text.
whenAvoid: The loading takes up a whole block of the screen → `spinner` or `skeleton`.
You know how much is left → `progress`.
dos: Size them to the text they accompany. They inherit the color and size from their context.
In a button, keep the width so it doesn’t jump when the text comes back.
donts: Don’t use them as the main indicator for a long load. They don’t communicate progress.
Don’t leave them animating once the operation has finished or failed.
